events.title: Loading a dump truck
events.detail: Loaded swing right to ~85°, 9 s cycle. Truck driver standing by his cab.

events.title: Fatigue signs detected
events.detail: Cab camera: repeated yawning in the 10th hour of shift. Break suggested.

events.title: Microsleep: eyes closed 1.2 s
events.detail: Loaded bucket swinging at 34°/s toward the truck driver.

events.title: Swing held, seat vibration and alarm
events.detail: Hydraulics soft-stopped. Operator must acknowledge to continue.

events.title: Without assist: bucket strikes the truck driver
events.detail: Swing continues past the dump point during the microsleep.

events.title: Operator wakes and acknowledges
events.detail: Bucket returned to the dump point. Break logged, supervisor notified.

outcome.assisted: Swing held at 92°, short of the driver at 125°. Operator woke, acknowledged and was rotated to a break.
outcome.unassisted: Loaded bucket swings through the truck driver standing by his cab.
